brief: Trump cancels Iran strikes pending rapid deal, while Ceuta migrant crisis fuels far-right rallies in Europe. Research highlights AI in landscape design and nutritional impacts of animal production.
news_summary: Trump says he canceled strikes on Iran citing progress on a deal, while far-right leaders intensify calls to expel migrants in Ceuta after last week's influx.
papers_summary: Papers explore AI's role in landscape design, animal production's effect on human omega-3 status, and lifestyle factors in Alzheimer's prevention.

zh.brief: 今日新闻聚焦特朗普取消对伊打击及欧洲移民危机，论文方面则呈现跨学科研究，涵盖AI、营养与教育等领域。
zh.news_summary: 特朗普称已取消对伊朗打击，前提是能迅速达成协议，且伊朗等中东国家请求暂缓攻击。西班牙休达移民危机持续，极右翼势力借机炒作，欧盟政治分歧加剧。
zh.papers_summary: 研究指出AI正进入景观设计，营养学探讨生产方式对人类健康影响，教育学则聚焦数学学习中的求助策略。
